facts.fact: Cabinet approved the Seychelles Digital and AI Strategy 2026-2031 on Wednesday 28 October 2026, projected to cost $50 million over five years, says the Seychelles News Agency.

Cabinet also approved an Inter-Ministerial Digital and AI Coordination Committee chaired by the Vice-President to support implementation, and a Digital Transformation Division monitors delivery, says Principal Secretary Choppy.
